name: app-screen
label: A rebuilt app screen where ONE thing happens on the word: a badge lands, a toggle turns on, a row is marked

variant.label: phone = a phone rising from below, sheet = a settings panel, browser = a browser window

title.label: Screen title (sheet and browser; blank = the app name)

rows.default: Morning walk;7 days in a row;on|Read 10 pages;3 days;toggle|Drink water;today
rows.label: Rows Label;sub;control|... (control = toggle, on, a short value, or blank)

hot_row.label: The row the action lands on (1 = first)

tap_at.label: When a cursor taps the hot thing (blank = no tap)

pop.label: What the tap opens: title|one line (blank = nothing)

out.label: cut = hold to the end, edge = leave
